notes.title: Football Dream Team Service Notice
notes.notes:
Dear players

"Football Dream Team" has received strong support and love from all the players since its official launch. We have spent countless happy days with you since the opening of the service. We sincerely appreciate your support and help!

However, due to force majeure, the game will officially stop operation on April 18, 2023.

In the next period of time, we will still try our best to do a good job in the operation of the game and try our best to meet your game experience. Here is the service suspension arrangement. Please also be ready:

1. From now on to the official service closing period, players can log in to the game normally;

2. At 9:30 on March 21, 2023, the registration and recharging will be closed. After closing the recharging, the remaining money of the characters in the game can still be consumed;

3. The server will be officially shut down at 9:30 on April 18, 2023.




Football Dream Team Operation Team

notes.title: Version 6.4.5.0 maintenance and update
notes.notes:
Version 6.4.5.0 maintenance and update

This maintenance update is expected to be from 6:30 on November 17 to 15:00 on November 17

1. Adjust the number of rounds from 12 to 8. There is no elimination system, and the scores have been ranked.

2. Novice 7-day login adjustment

3. Add seven days to collect countdown

4. Player contract can be directly used with tactical currency

5. The chain defense skill points are adjusted to 4 points, the wind skill points are adjusted to 3 points, the lower floor maniac skill points are adjusted to 3 points, the fish leaping to the top I and II skill points are adjusted to 3 points, the amazing side ditch I and II skill points are adjusted to 3 points, and the scorpion tail swinging skill points are adjusted to 3 points.

6. The skill adjustment of wind and bottom maniac will not be blocked by the tackle skill

7. Peter Pan I and II skill adjustment will not be trapped by chain defense

8. If the upgrade fails, the item will no longer disappear. Only the cost and upgrade gems will be deducted.

9. Optimize anti addiction system

notes.title: [Version 6.2.1.0 updated content] New mode: city invitational
notes.notes:
1. New City Invitational

Open the invitational tournament for five major cities in Tokyo, London, Paris, Qatar and the world.

Tokyo City Invitational: 100 diamonds for registration fee, 300 diamonds for the first prize, 200 diamonds for the first prize, and 100 diamonds for the third prize

London City Invitational: registration fee 300 diamonds, first prize 900 diamonds, first prize 600 diamonds, third prize 300 diamonds

Paris City Invitational: 500 diamonds for registration fee, 1500 diamonds for the first prize, 1000 diamonds for the first prize, and 500 diamonds for the third prize

Qatar City Invitational: 1000 diamonds for registration fee, 3000 diamonds for the first prize, 2000 diamonds for the first prize, and 1000 diamonds for the third prize

World City Invitational: 3000 diamonds for registration fee, 9000 diamonds for the first prize, 6000 diamonds for the first prize, and 3000 diamonds for the third prize

You can participate in the city invitational tournament 3 times a day.

Each city invitational tournament will have 12 rounds and will be eliminated at the end after 8 rounds. The top three will be rewarded.

2. New city invitational league table

The ranking is based on the cumulative number of diamonds obtained from the city invitational tournament, and the first to third places have special team badges to show their identity.

The ranking list is cleared at the beginning of each month and the records are calculated again.

3. New Daily Task

Add daily tasks of the city invitational competition, complete the task reward and transfer to music gift certificate * 1

4. Adjust the waiting time of each round of guild war

Adjust the waiting time of each round to 30 seconds.

notes.title: Football dream team core gameplay
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41714603/18962ccc3fc0105c34a0c65a4c8776f5b9561b6b.png[/img]
1. Competition mode: 12 rounds of 8-player battles, starting from the 8th round.

■ Fight each round with a random opponent.

■ 8 points for a 3 goal difference win, 5 points for a 2 goal difference win, 3 points for a 1 goal difference win, 1 point for a draw, no points for defeat and no penalty.

2. Turn operation:

■ Each round is divided into two stages: the preparation stage and the competition stage.

■ Preparation stage:

- Buy players with tactical coins automatically earned by the system each turn.

- After the player is purchased, put them in the preparation area and drag them into action.

- Formations can be changed.

- Tactics can be changed.

- Sell players (70% of original price).

■ Competition Stage:

- Can watch players play automatically, also can buy and sell, players up and down.

- At the end of the match, a random piece of equipment is acquired, which can be exchanged for other equipment for players on the court.

- Formations can be changed.

- Tactics can be changed.

- Sell players (70% of original price).

3. Operation mode

■ Formation selection:

- Each formation has its own unique style of play and bonuses to its formation attributes.

- The player's own position attributes affect his on-field attributes.

■ Player selection:

- Players are divided into star, legend, world class and god.

- A player's skill sets have a lot to do with the player's characteristics and tactics.

■ Reward at the end of the race:

- Experience points (improves club level).

- Easter Eggs (random items or skill books, etc.)
